integrity: Self-contained theorem proved by Cauchy--Schwarz and Fourier orthogonality. Finite exact checks support but do not establish universal quantifiers. Literature comparison leaves historical priority risk.
scientific_limitations: Only positive even exponents, finite coefficient support, discrete abelian groups and reflection-invariant masks; no sharp constants or phase uniqueness; earlier equivalent symmetrization may exist.
title: Reflection root-mean-square majorization of every even Fourier moment
